steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Define application name, package name, and project metadata in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Define Offline API Schema
steps.description: Establish offline architecture schema without external server requirement in api_schema.json.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Configuration
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with SDK 34, Java 8 compilation compatibility, and no external dependencies.

steps.title: Declare App Permissions and Manifest
steps.description: Declare CAMERA, VIBRATE, and storage permissions in AndroidManifest.xml using standard Material theme.

steps.title: Create Color and String Resources
steps.description: Define high-contrast modern dark-accent color palette, UI text, and styles in res/values.

steps.title: Create Modern Card and Shape Drawables
steps.description: Build custom card layouts, tab selectors, and scanner viewfinder reticle drawables.

steps.title: Construct Unified Multi-Tab Activity Layout
steps.description: Implement responsive layout featuring Tab controls, Generator view, Live Camera scanner, and Gallery decoder in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement Native QR Code Generator Engine
steps.description: Build high-performance pure Java Reed-Solomon error correction and 2D matrix encoder in QRCodeEncoder.java.

steps.title: Implement Native QR Code Analyzer and Decoder Engine
steps.description: Build pure Java image luminance analyzer, finder-pattern locator, and data extractor in QRCodeDecoder.java.

steps.title: Implement Native Camera Surface Viewfinder
steps.description: Construct hardware camera preview SurfaceView component with auto-focus and frame callback in CameraPreview.java.

steps.title: Assemble Main Application Logic
steps.description: Connect QR creation, live scanning, gallery picking, audio-haptic feedback, and web actions in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Building Smart QR Studio
steps.description: Assemble and build the final native Android debug APK package.
